Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzes the effect of L-PGDS treatment on surgically excised human cornea from TGFBI-CD patients. The design is paired as the tissue was dissected into equal halves for treatment and control. L-PGDS is mapped to the broad 'chemical or drug treatment' category as it is used here as a therapeutic agent/chaperone protein; no more specific child class in the provided ontology (like 'proteostasis modulator') explicitly covers exogenous chaperone protein application without being a small molecule inhibitor/activator.

MStype_prompt.notes: Although PRIDE metadata lists 'Top-down proteomics' under experimentTypes, the detailed methods explicitly describe a bottom-up workflow: proteins were 'reduced, alkylated, digested and cleaned-up' using the EasyPep Mini MS Sample Prep Kit, and analyzed via DIA (DirectDIA) using Spectronaut. The 'Top-down' label in PRIDE is likely an error. No specific PTM enrichment was performed for the proteomics run; the study focuses on amyloid disaggregation.
